text: dsh-neubrutalism-theme 是一款适用于 DSH Web 客户端的新粗野主义界面主题。它通过 Web 客户端注入明暗主题 token、字体和全局 CSS，将配色、方形边角、粗描边与零模糊硬阴影应用到界面组件。按钮、输入框、弹窗、代码块和表格等元素获得统一的边框与交互反馈，同时提供本地嵌入字体；停用插件时会清除样式并恢复主题 token。适合希望为 DSH Web 界面更换为高对比、平面色彩和硬边视觉风格的用户。代码未显示需要 API key 或外部服务。

dsh-neubrutalism-theme restyles DSH Web with light and dark palettes, square corners, bold outlines, hard shadows, and bundled fonts. Its client installs theme tokens and CSS, then removes them on disable. For users seeking a high-contrast, hard-edged interface.
想把 DSH 网页界面换成粗边框、方角和硬阴影的风格。
能给 DSH Web 加一套同时支持浅色和深色的高对比主题吗？
How can I give the DSH browser UI a bold, square-cornered theme with hard shadows?
dsh-neubrutalism-theme 的功能「明暗主题」：为 DSH Web 提供浅色和深色 token，并注入方角、粗描边与硬阴影样式；停用时撤销覆盖并移除样式。
dsh-neubrutalism-theme 的功能「界面字体与组件样式」：通过客户端样式为标题、正文和代码指定字体，并统一按钮、输入框、弹窗、代码块等组件的边框、阴影和悬停反馈。样式由 Web 客户端载入，字体数据随客户端包内嵌。

dsh-neubrutalism-theme README · dsh-neubrutalism-theme：English | [中文](README.zh.md)

A Neubrutalism Web UI theme for DeepSeek Harness.

dsh-neubrutalism-theme README · Features：- Light and dark themes
- Hard shadows, bold outlines, and square corners
- Custom typography
- No external font requests
- Installs as a DSH plugin
- Uninstalling immediately restores the original DSH UI

dsh-neubrutalism-theme README · Visual system and fonts：The theme follows the visual grammar in the [Neubrutalism guide](https://neubrutalism.com/): 2px control outlines, 3px container outlines, square corners, zero-blur offset shadows, a limited flat accent palette, and tactile lift/press button feedback.

dsh-neubrutalism-theme README · Visual system and fonts：- The light palette starts from `#FFFDF5` and uses `#FFD23F`, `#FF6B6B`, `#74B9FF`, `#88D498`, `#FFA552`, and `#B8A9FA` as accents.
- Dark mode keeps the same hierarchy with dark surfaces, off-white outlines, and bright accents.
- Elevation uses compact 2px, 4px, and 6px hard-shadow offsets; secondary message actions step down to 1px.
- Display: Syne Variable 800.
- Headings and controls: Space Grotesk Variable 700.
- Body: Inter Variable, with platform CJK fallbacks.
- Code: Space Mono 400/700.

dsh-neubrutalism-theme README · Visual system and fonts：Fontsource packages provide the fonts. The build embeds only the Latin WOFF2 files as data URLs in `lib/client.js`, so the browser makes no Google Fonts request and does not require system-installed copies.

dsh-neubrutalism-theme README · Install：```sh
git clone https://github.com/MoriTang/dsh-neubrutalism-theme.git
```

The repository includes built artifacts, so users do not need to run `pnpm install` or rebuild it. Register the plugin with the `web` profile from a Harness checkout:

```sh
cd /path/to/deepseek-harness
pnpm dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/to/dsh-neubrutalism-theme
```

dsh-neubrutalism-theme README · Install：Restart `pnpm dsh web` after registration. The bundle patch inserts the Host Loader row, while package metadata exposes `lib/client.js` as its Web client half.

Remove it with:

```sh
pnpm dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-neubrutalism-theme
```

Cordis effects own both the token overrides and the `<style>` element. Loader disposal removes both and immediately restores the base DSH theme.

dsh-neubrutalism-theme README · Develop：Source development requires a DeepSeek Harness checkout. Place both repositories under the same parent directory:

```text
src/
├── deepseek-harness/
└── dsh-neubrutalism-theme/
```

The plugin resolves DSH development dependencies through `link:../deepseek-harness/...`. Standard build tools and font packages come from npm:

```sh
cd /path/to/dsh-neubrutalism-theme
pnpm install
pnpm run typecheck
pnpm test

dsh-neubrutalism-theme README · Develop：This release targets the DeepSeek Harness `0.1.2-alpha.2` series. Harness does not yet promise stable compatibility, so rerun these checks and verify the Web UI after upgrading Harness.
